tools.name: calculate_chart
tools.description: Calculates an account-free temporary natal chart from supplied birth details. Birth date is required; omitted time and source default to unknown and unspecified. Optional time precision includes exact, approximate with explicit minutes, bounded_range and day_period. Optional birthplace is a historic

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns the connected Novamris account's stable opaque identifier and optional display name for account recognition across reconnects. Requires account authorization and accepts no account selectors. Excludes email addresses and birth details.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Returns the connected person's current saved natal chart, readable placements and birth-time uncertainty. Requires account authorization and chart access. Accepts no birth details or profile identifiers. Missing or stale saved charts produce an unavailable result.

tools.name: get_timing_month
tools.description: Returns a calendar month of personal astrology periods for a temporary chartContext or the authorized saved self chart. Saved access requires the full_timing entitlement; temporary access requires a confirmed viewing timezone unless already present in context. Relative months resolve in the viewing

tools.name: get_timing_year
tools.description: Returns annual personal astrology periods for a temporary chartContext or the authorized saved self chart. Saved access requires full_timing; temporary access requires a confirmed viewing timezone. The reading field combines annual ranks 1–15, all calculated eclipse contacts and up to five remaining

tools.name: get_daily_focus
tools.description: Returns today's personal chart contacts and deterministic reflection from the Novamris Today editorial catalog. Today resolves in the confirmed viewing or account timezone. Supports temporary chartContext and the authorized saved self chart without a full_timing entitlement. An absent editorial mess

tools.name: compare_dates
tools.description: Returns a comparison of one to eight distinct civil dates from the same personal chart and sampled Calendar contacts. Supports temporary chartContext with a confirmed viewing timezone or the authorized saved self chart with full_timing access. Relative chart emphasis is not a favorable-outcome score

findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, get_timing_month, get_daily_focus · Private data: get_timing_year, get_daily_focus, compare_dates · Public sink: get_profile, get_timing_month.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, get_timing_month, get_daily_focus · Private data: get_timing_year, get_daily_focus, compare_dates · Public sink: get_profile, get_timing_month

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
